For a zero-sum vector write \(x_i=c_i\) for \(i=0,\ldots,12\), so \(c_\ast=-\sum_i x_i\). At \(s=0,p=1\),
\[
\sum_{z,w}c_zc_wd_0(z,w)=x^TMx,
\]
where the \(13\times13\) matrix \(M\), indexed by \(0,\ldots,12\), is obtained from
\[
M_{ij}=d_0(i,j)-d_0(\ast,i)-d_0(\ast,j).
\]
A direct shortest-path calculation gives that \(-M\) has LDL pivots
\[
14,\frac{48}{7},\frac{20}{3},8,8,\frac{22}{5},8,\frac{58}{11},
\frac{54}{29},\frac{74}{27},\frac{94}{37},\frac{104}{47},0.
\]
Thus \(M\) is negative semidefinite with one-dimensional kernel. The normalized kernel vector is
\[
(a_\ast,a_0,\ldots,a_{12})
=(2,-2,1,0,0,2,-2,-2,0,2,0,0,1,-2).
\]
Hence \((Y,d_0)\) has \(1\)-negative type but not strict \(1\)-negative type.

For this vector,
\[
\left.\frac{d}{dp}\right|_{p=1}\sum_{z,w}a_za_wd_0(z,w)^p
=\sum_{z,w}a_za_wd_0(z,w)\log d_0(z,w).
\]
Collecting equal distances gives
\[
\tau=\log\!\left(
\frac{2^{20}3^{219}23^{46}}
{5^{35}7^7 11^{22}13^{26}17^{34}}
\right).
\]
This is positive, so for \(p>1\) close to \(1\), the kernel direction becomes positive; therefore \(\wp(0)=1\).

For the \(s\)-perturbation, near \(s=0\) the only first-order changes in distances from \(\ast\) are
\[
h=(0,0,-1,-1,-1,0,0,0,1,1,1,0,0),
\]
indexed by \(0,\ldots,12\). The induced first derivative matrix on zero-sum coordinates is
\[
A_{ij}=-h_i-h_j.
\]
For \(x=(a_0,\ldots,a_{12})\), one has \(x^TAx=0\), so \(\wp'(0)=0\). Also
\[
Ax=(0,0,-2,-2,-2,0,0,0,2,2,2,0,0).
\]
Solving \(Mw=Ax\) with \(x^Tw=0\) gives
\[
w=(0,-\tfrac12,0,0,\tfrac12,0,0,0,-\tfrac12,0,0,\tfrac12,0),
\]
and therefore
\[
(Ax)^Tw=-2.
\]
The Schur-complement second derivative of the critical quadratic form is
\[
F_{ss}=-2(Ax)^Tw=4.
\]
Since \(F_p=4\tau\),
\[
\wp''(0)=-\frac{F_{ss}}{F_p}=-\frac1{\tau},
\]
so
\[
\kappa=\tau\wp''(0)=-1.
\]

\[
\boxed{\left(1,\ \log\!\left(\frac{2^{20}3^{219}23^{46}}{5^{35}7^7 11^{22}13^{26}17^{34}}\right),\ -1\right)}
\]
